text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One effective approach is using SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. This method helps teams stay focused and track progress. Breaking a project into milestones allows you to monitor achievements along the way, while clearly defined deliverables show what needs to be completed. It is also important to ensure stakeholder alignment, meaning everyone involved agrees on the objectives from the start. When goals are well planned and everyone understands them, projects are more likely to run smoothly and reach a successful conclusion.
